name: Pretty Things
main: Heart-Shaped Bow, the Final Proof of Cuteness

gist.Moonlight Butterfly: Tiny creature that can fly back to hand at the end of your turn and sting the hero opposite.
gist.Golden Apple: Borrows one of your heroes for a turn; her only real threat.
gist.Magic Ruby: Stuns one of your heroes for a turn.
gist.Magic Sapphire: Returns a spell from her discard pile.
gist.Rainbow's Arrow: An attack rider with nothing to attack with.
gist.Angelfeather Arrow: Another arrow for attacks she does not have.
gist.Glass Sword: One extra-hard hit for a hero with no attack card.
gist.Cute Bird: Would fetch a Cute Phoenix she does not own.
gist.Light Ball: Her other heroes are immune to statuses.
gist.Swan of Spun Glass: Invented card: a fragile swan that heals her heroes a little.
gist.Rose-Gold Tiara: Invented card: its hero dodges the first attack or spell each turn.

plan: Victoria chose her cards for how they look. There are arrows without attacks, a Cute Bird without a Phoenix, gems of every colour and a great deal of healing. What actually does something is Golden Apple, Magic Ruby, the Butterflies' stings and the fact that three healers take a while to burn down. There is no engine, no finisher and no plan; she wins only if you beat yourself.

looks.early: A butterfly, a swan and a tiara.
looks.mid: Gems played one a turn, a hero healed that was barely hurt.
looks.late: The same pretty board, slightly more scratched.

custom.name: Swan of Spun Glass
custom.text: A very fragile swan; while it stands, her heroes heal a little each turn.

custom.name: Rose-Gold Tiara
custom.text: Expensive; its hero cannot be chosen by the first attack or spell each turn.

opening.tell: Her board is a butterfly and a glass swan.
opening.why: Nothing she has threatens you, so take the free turns for the Storm; there is no engine to disrupt.

midgame.tell: She heals a hero each turn and plays a gem.
midgame.why: Healing only matters against slow damage: focus one small hero at a time.

crisis.tell: She holds a Golden Apple and is looking at your caster.
crisis.why: Her one dangerous card makes your own hero hit you: keep a shield for that turn and finish her.

endgame.tell: Mary is alone and out of heals.

opening.board: Victoria arranges a Swan of Spun Glass and a Moonlight Butterfly so the colours match.

options.text: Search for an engine to break

opening.board: She equips a Rose-Gold Tiara and admires it.
A Butterfly flutters back to her hand and stings Nicolas.

midgame.board: Magic Emerald mills three of your cards; she claps.
Healing Melody on three unhurt heroes.

crisis.board: Golden Apple: your caster turns on you for a turn.

options.text: Cloud in a Bottle, then finish Beato

crisis.board: Magic Ruby stuns your caster twice running.
Light Ball makes two of her heroes immune to your freeze.
